name: Ila

lines.text: The glass is hers. I only keep it swept and the trays turned.
She is not coming this month. She sends soil, and I plant it, and I write down what comes up. Mostly nothing comes up.
That is the point of it -- the nothing. If you only sow good dirt you learn what you already knew. She wants the ground that has stopped, and a list of what will still take in it.

Physic first, because sick people cannot wait for a harvest. Neem for the skin, brahmi for the head, haritaki for everything nobody has a name for. Then the grasses, because grass holds a slope. Then whatever will feed anyone.

Seed keeps in a jar or it does not keep. She had me fire my own the first winter, from the river clay below the cutting -- one for every tray, the lid ground down until it sits. Make one before you make anything else of mine.
Sandalwood for a comb, and not for the smell. Nothing that lives in hair will stay in it. A billet is worth more than the comb, so the comb is cut from what is left when the billet is sold.
The lotus in the falling-up water keeps its warmth after it is picked. I have not worked out what that is for. She will know, or she will write to somebody who does.

Soma? Guyuk says it grew on Meru once, and now only in the stony ground below it. One cup and a carrier walks three days without bread or sleep. She says it is not a gift, it is a loan -- and the fourth day collects.

notes:
**The apothecary thread, given somebody to say it.** The brief for this map asked that a player learn how apothecary works and how it rebuilds -- and the atelier said soil samples and seed trays, which is agriculture. Ila is the half that was missing: physic first because sick people cannot wait for a harvest, then grass because grass holds a slope, then food.

An apprentice rather than Guyuk herself. Canon has the Seed-Gleaner aboard the Survival Train in `event_survival_train_solarpunk`, and a workshop nobody is currently in is the stronger image for this map anyway. Ila keeps it, plants what Guyuk sends, and writes down what comes up -- which is mostly nothing, and the nothing is the data.

She is at the rail-head as well as the bench, because that is where the soil arrives and where the letters go.

Her soma line is the owner's ask of 4 October 2026: one person, named or not, saying what soma does. Ila because the pressing is the Aravali glass-herbalists' custom and her teacher is the herbalist who would know. It gives nothing -- soma is lore and the game does not carry it yet.
